[[Category:Old Tranquil Methodist Cemetery, Newberry County, South Carolina]]

== Biography ==
'''Mary Caroline Glasgow''' was born on 17 September 1785 in South Carolina.<ref name="Memorial">[https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/144856288/mary_c-wright Find a Grave memorial 144856288], Mary C. Glasgow Wright, Old Tranquil Methodist Cemetery, Newberry County, South Carolina (accessed 12 August 2026).</ref>

Mary married [[Wright-73441|Zaccheus Wright]] on 7 December 1809 in Abbeville, South Carolina.<ref name="WrightAccount">[https://www.geocities.ws/richmond01_2000/wright.html "Family: Wright"], account of Zaccheus Wright and Mary Glasgow (accessed 12 August 2026).</ref> Their daughter [[Wright-73437|Elizabeth Wright]] was born in 1815.

Mary died on 6 September 1841 and was buried at Old Tranquil Methodist Cemetery in Newberry County.<ref name="Memorial" />

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1983]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The held 1835 equity-partition citation explicitly identifies Mary Wright among Robert’s surviving children, supplementing the Wright family attribution, 1800 age-slot fit and Zaccheus’s estate administration. Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSR8-XSB3-K Newberry District, South Carolina, equity partition of the estate of Robert Glasgow, 1835; FamilySearch image (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSR8-XSB3-K).]; [https://www.geocities.ws/richmond01_2000/wright.html "Family: Wright" (https://www.geocities.ws/richmond01_2000/wright.html), account of Zaccheus Wright and Mary Glasgow (accessed 12 August 2026).]; [https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/1800nbycensusG.htm "1800 Newberry District census" (https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/1800 nbycensusG.htm), Robert Glasgow household (accessed 12 August 2026); citing NARA microfilm publication M32, roll 50.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The 1835 equity partition of Robert Glasgow's estate directly identifies Mary Wright as one of [[Glasgow-1983|Robert Glasgow]]'s surviving children.<ref name="RobertEstate1835">Newberry District, South Carolina, equity partition of the estate of Robert Glasgow, 1835; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSR8-XSB3-K FamilySearch image].</ref> This proves Robert as Mary's father. The proceeding also names her husband, [[Wright-73441|Zaccheus Wright]].

The 1800 census and Wright family account remain useful supporting evidence.<ref>[https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/1800nbycensusG.htm "1800 Newberry District census"], Robert Glasgow household (accessed 12 August 2026); citing NARA microfilm publication M32, roll 50.</ref><ref name="WrightAccount" /> The partition does not identify Mary's mother; [[Kinard-572|Elizabeth Kinard]] remains attached from the broader family reconstruction rather than this direct record.
